description: The annotation, kept on a configuration class, that makes Spring create the proxies for cache annotations.
An annotation that returns the stored value on a hit and runs the method body only on a miss.
An annotation that always runs the method and refreshes the cached entry with the result.
An annotation that removes an entry, or all entries, once the method completes without error.
An explicit key expression such as #id that avoids collisions between methods sharing a cache.
A cached copy that no longer matches the database because a write path did not evict or update it.
